entities.name: Homarids
entities.description: Sapient lobster-like creatures that thrive in the cold waters of Dominaria; their infants are called Camarids.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: Plane whose cold waters homarids inhabit.

entities.name: Vodalia
entities.description: Merfolk empire off Sarpadia whose fall was hastened by homarid conflict.

entities.name: Etlan Shiis
entities.description: Merfolk who sought to avenge fallen Vodalia and conflicted with the viscerids.

entities.name: Kjeldorans
entities.description: Humans who named the homarids viscerids.

entities.name: Sylex Blast
entities.description: Event that shattered the tectonic plate between Terisiare and Sarpadia, creating a trench.

entities.name: Brothers' War
entities.description: War after which the homarids migrated north.

events.summary: After the Brothers' War the homarids migrate north from the antarctic as global cooling sets in.
events.quote: the homarids migrated northward in the centuries after the Brothers' War

events.summary: Homarids come into conflict with the merfolk of Vodalia, hastening the empire's fall.
After Vodalia falls, homarids discover the trench created by the Sylex Blast as a haven and migration route.
events.quote: After the fall of Vodalia, the homarids discovered this trench

events.summary: After the Ice Age the homarids contact human civilizations; Kjeldorans name them viscerids.
